name: preview card
what: A linked tile for one child page: a picture (or a sentence) above its title; the wall an index page is built from.
padding: padding 0 and no background at Page.css:1186; the thumb carries the box
notes: Needs a Page instance (preview_card(nav, thumb)), so render is null. Count is files of any type mentioning the class.

name: preview wall
what: The wrapping grid of preview cards that an index page shows for its children; may carry group headings.
padding: none of its own; padding-inline var(--gutter-x) in .page.standard
bleeds: yes: the .bleed word takes the widest grid track
notes: walls() (Page.class.js:869) nests one wall per grandchild group. Rail form .rail:has(> .page-preview) forces 11em cards (Page.css:1037).

name: wireframe picture
what: A chrome-free mini drawing of a page shape (29 words), used as a preview card thumbnail instead of a zoomed live render.
render: import { mini } from '/framework/ext/demo/mini.js'; import { div } from '/app.js'; div.c('card', () => mini('tabs'));
padding: none; parts size themselves in em (mini.css)
notes: Trap from the readme: a PART is .demo-mini-x, a PICTURE .demo-mini--x; one dash misapplies padding.

name: wireframe tile
what: One tiny grey rectangle inside a wireframe picture; a stand-in for a card.
notes: Another spelling of a box with surface fill and hairline; a drawing, not a real card.

name: card
what: The framework's one padded, bordered surface for a heading and text; optional coloured status edge and selected ring.
render: import { div, h4, p } from '/app.js'; div.c('card', () => { h4('Title'); p('A card holds a heading and a paragraph.'); });
notes: Count is files with c("card. The 3px edge is always reserved. framework.css:456 says 180 hand-rolled card classes were the reason .card exists.

name: surface
what: The card look without its padding: fill, hairline, radius.
render: import { div, p } from '/app.js'; div.c('surface pad', () => p('A surface needs .pad added.'));
notes: Twin of .card: forgetting the second word gives an unpadded box, the trap .card was made to remove. Count is files with c("surface.

name: wash
what: A background-only tint box (no border, no padding).
render: import { div, p } from '/app.js'; div.c('wash pad', () => p('Tinted ground.'));
notes: --tint once had no class and painted nothing silently (framework.css comment after line 503).

name: decks card
what: A small tinted, bordered link tile in the decks lab.
notes: Duplicate of .card with its own padding; decks.css is copied verbatim under layouts/labs/.

name: blog card
what: A surface-coloured article tile with a hairline on two sides and a hover shade.
notes: A third card padding; box-shadow instead of a border.

name: three-column card
what: One wide row of three columns (facts, main content, meta) in the imagine realm.
notes: Named card but is a grid layout; collapses to one column in a query.

name: v3 tile
what: A clickable board tile in the AI dashboard: icon, title, one sentence, footer.
padding: set elsewhere in v3.css (not read in full)
notes: Own background token --v3-card and its own selected look (box-shadow none): a fork of .card.selected.

name: dev chat card
what: A message card in the dev bar chat.
notes: A test copy sits in ai/2026-09-19/devbar-chat/test/chat-test.css:54.

name: ai2 card page
what: A Page styled as a card on the ai2 board.
notes: A Page pretending to be a card.

name: paging box
what: A vertical stack of headings and paragraphs used as swappable content in the paging lab.
notes: Prose is limited to --measure (paging.css:30).

name: section band
what: A full-width themed strip (hero, callout, stats, faq...) from the section library; each section is a function returning a band.
bleeds: yes: full-width band with an inner .measure
notes: Count is files. Sections hand-build inner boxes (stats uses div.c('pad flex v')) rather than .card.

name: stat tile
what: A padded label-over-big-number box inside the stats section.
notes: Built from utility words, not .card: another spelling of a small padded box.

name: demo shell
what: The whole demo band: path above, render in a stage, source column beside; what page.demo() draws.
render: import { demo } from '/app.js'; demo(() => { h1('Hello'); }, 'Caption - the code shown IS the code that ran.');
notes: Splits to two columns from ~1310px of its own width.

name: demo stage
what: One resizable viewport with a width readout and preset widths 390/810/1440/3440.
render: import { demo } from '/app.js'; demo.stage(() => p('Drag the handle.'));
notes: The three nested boxes cannot merge (overflow). A div is not a viewport: @media inside ignores the handle.

name: demo app
what: A Page tree playing App and Router inside a box.
render: import { demo } from '/app.js'; import sample from '/framework/ext/demo/sample.js'; demo.app(sample());
notes: Defaults urls:false; hides its own width readout inside stages and preview cards. sample.js default export was not verified.

name: demo steps
what: A two-column hero: numbered steps beside a live demo, each step ticking when the demo fires its event.
notes: Needs a stage function and event names, so render is null.

name: omnibox
what: The search box and results in the site chrome.
notes: Count is all files mentioning it.

name: tab panel
what: The content pane belonging to one tab of a tabbed page.
padding: panel unset; a direct .page child gets padding 0 (compound.css:73)
notes: Count is files.

name: editing panel
what: The ext/Panel editor: bar, body, workspace, items, props, grips.
notes: The word panel is overloaded: the 94 .panel rules top the class census; .tab-panel and .paging-tab-panel mean something else.
